info.title: Tenure System Studio — control plane
info.description: The Studio's HTTP face. Every 2xx read is an ApiEnvelope; every non-2xx is RFC 7807 problem+json, and there is no other way to produce one. Generated by tools/contract-schemas.mjs from packages/contracts/src/index.ts — the component schemas below are the objects the runtime parsers execute, not a description of them.

servers.description: The Studio origin. Never a tenant origin (PD-007).

operatorSession.name: authjs.session-token
operatorSession.description: An operator session. There is no API key and no bearer token; every route calls auth().

EstateResource.title: EstateResource
EstateResource.description: One resource observed in AWS by the Studio's read plane, sanitized for an operator surface.

CostFigure.title: CostFigure
CostFigure.description: One money figure the control plane publishes, with the period and the system it came from.

DriftFinding.title: DriftFinding
DriftFinding.description: One difference between the estate as observed and the estate as declared.

ChangeDiff.title: ChangeDiff
ChangeDiff.description: What a change does, in every domain the control plane can actually compute one for.

ApiEnvelope.title: ApiEnvelope
ApiEnvelope.description: The 2xx body every control-plane read endpoint returns. Non-2xx is RFC 7807 problem+json, never this.

ProblemDocument.title: ProblemDocument
ProblemDocument.description: RFC 7807. The only non-2xx body this control plane produces.

get.summary: Every tenant this operator may read.
get.description: One page of the tenant registry. `format=csv` returns text/csv with an `x-refused-count` header naming how many tenants were withheld by authorization rather than silently dropped.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page, capped by the platform ceiling (MAX_PAGE).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token. AES-256-GCM sealed; not decodable by a client.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to `csv` for a text/csv export.

304.description: The ETag matched. No body, deliberately.

get.summary: One tenant's long-running lifecycle operations, and the way to start one.
get.description: GET requires `slug`. POST requires an `Idempotency-Key` header and runs the same server action the console form runs, so no control the browser path enforces can be skipped over HTTP.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The tenant. Required — operations are per tenant.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page, capped by the platform ceiling (MAX_PAGE).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token. AES-256-GCM sealed; not decodable by a client.

304.description: The ETag matched. No body, deliberately.

post.summary: One tenant's long-running lifecycle operations, and the way to start one.
post.description: GET requires `slug`. POST requires an `Idempotency-Key` header and runs the same server action the console form runs, so no control the browser path enforces can be skipped over HTTP.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The tenant. Required — operations are per tenant.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page, capped by the platform ceiling (MAX_PAGE).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token. AES-256-GCM sealed; not decodable by a client.

to.description: The lifecycle state to advance to.

200.description: Accepted. A replay returns 200 as well — two identical requests that returned different statuses would make the second look like a different outcome.

get.description: Answers 501 when no cost source is connected. Never 200 with an empty list — "we looked and there is nothing" and "nothing was connected to look at" are opposite facts about a fleet's bill.

304.description: The ETag matched. No body, deliberately.
